candidates.title: Civitai prompt 149473166
candidates.prompt: A young woman with a high ponytail stands in profile against a dark, graffiti-splashed wall, her hair glowing with electric streaks of cyan and tangerine as if lit from within. She wears a faded black t-shirt with a teal graphic, slightly rumpled and dusted with glowing particles that cling to her skin and collarbone. Her face is softly illuminated by the ambient neon, casting subtle shadows and catching a few tiny, dangling earrings that shimmer like dew. Behind her, vibrant spray-painted tags in pink, teal, and burnt orange drip down the surface, while a warm orange neon outline frames the background, adding depth and contrast. The composition is intimate and cinematic, framing her from the shoulders up in a tight medium close-up that emphasizes her contemplative gaze into the dim distance. The entire scene is bathed in a cool-toned cyberpunk glow, blending street art grit with ethereal luminescence, rendered in a hyper-detailed, semi-realistic style that feels both grounded and otherworldly.
